description.value:
You carry a knack for cobbling together useful gadgets from spare parts. Given ten minutes and access to a set of tools you're proficient with, you can construct one temporary gadget of your choice: a stimshot (restores 2d4 hit points to a creature that uses it as an action), a signal jammer (imposes disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to detect creatures within 30 feet of it for 1 hour), or a shock trap (a creature that steps within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 lightning damage).

You can have no more than one such gadget active at a time, and you can construct a new one once per long rest.

system.requirements: Proficiency with tinker's tools or a similar artisan's tool.
